mentions.name: Gary Trent Jr.
mentions.analysis: Gary Trent Jr. is expected to play around 35 minutes and could provide two steals, three threes, and potentially 14 points and a rebound. He is a good streaming option for points and three-pointers, especially with the back-to-back advantage.

mentions.name: Scoot Henderson
mentions.analysis: Scoot Henderson should be rostered anyway, but he is highlighted as a useful option for the Sunday-Monday back-to-back combination.

mentions.name: Caleb Martin
mentions.analysis: Caleb Martin is expected to play a lot of minutes, potentially 40, and could contribute in points and three-pointers. However, his value drops after Sunday due to only two games next week.

mentions.name: Kyle Lowry
mentions.analysis: Kyle Lowry has been performing well in the first two games and could provide assists, potentially up to eight, making him a valuable streaming option.

mentions.name: Toumani Camara
mentions.analysis: Toumani Camara is starting and is a streaming option for deeper leagues, though his performance in game two was not as strong as in game one.

mentions.name: Andre Drummond
mentions.analysis: Andre Drummond is available in over 50% of leagues and is a good streaming option for points leagues, especially with the Sixers' schedule.

mentions.name: Dennis Schroder
mentions.analysis: Dennis Schroder is getting more shots than expected and is widely available, making him a good streaming option for points leagues.

mentions.name: Ben Simmons
mentions.analysis: Ben Simmons is highlighted for his value in points leagues, though he may sit one game of a back-to-back.

mentions.name: De'Andre Hunter
mentions.analysis: De'Andre Hunter is expected to have usage and minute opportunities, making him a good streaming option for points and three-pointers.

mentions.name: Jordan Hawkins
mentions.analysis: Jordan Hawkins had a strong performance in his last game and is a good streaming option for points and three-pointers.

mentions.name: Isaiah Jackson
mentions.analysis: Isaiah Jackson is a proven shot-blocker and can provide blocks and field goal percentage, making him a valuable streaming option.

mentions.name: Daniel Theis
mentions.analysis: Daniel Theis is starting and could provide rebounds and blocks, though his minutes are limited.

mentions.name: Javonte Green
mentions.analysis: Javonte Green is a good defensive player and could provide steals, making him a streaming option for deeper leagues.

mentions.name: Cason Wallace
mentions.analysis: Cason Wallace has high steals upside and is expected to play at least 20 minutes, making him a good streaming option for steals.

mentions.name: Luguentz Dort
mentions.analysis: Luguentz Dort can provide points, three-pointers, and steals, making him a versatile streaming option.
